admonitions.text: Do not use this command to hold a pose. Support the arm before you start it: the joints can move or sag when the actual load (for example, a payload or a tool) differs from the robot model.

fields.minimum_time: Minimum time to reach the target.
fields.position: Target joint positions (rad). One value per joint of the component, in its joint order.
fields.velocity_limit: Joint velocity limits (rad/s), one per joint. Leave empty to use the defaults.
fields.acceleration_limit: Joint acceleration limits (rad/s²), one per joint. Leave empty to use the defaults.
fields.stiffness: Joint stiffness (Nm/rad), one per joint. Must not be negative.
fields.torque_limit: Limit of the commanded joint torque (Nm), one per joint. Leave empty to use the defaults.

see_also.text: Control Hold Time and Minimum Time

fields.target_feedback_gain: Feedback gain of the last target, 0 to 10.
fields.target_feedforward_torque: Feedforward torque of the last target (Nm).

JointOperationService._source: core service/service.cpp JointOperationServiceImpl, robots/*/robot_hardware.cpp ExecuteJointCommand and SetJointPositionPIDGain; rby1-sdk v0.10.1 include/rby1-sdk/robot.h

methods.ServoOn: Turns on the servo (motor control) of the named joints. Rejected while the Control Manager is enabled.
methods.ServoOff: Turns off the servo of the named joints. Rejected while the Control Manager is enabled.
methods.BrakeEngage: Engages the brakes of the named joints. `name` supports regex patterns.
methods.BrakeRelease: Releases the brakes of the named joints. `name` supports regex patterns. Read the warning on this page first.
methods.HomeOffsetReset: Sets the current position of the named joints as their zero (home) position and overwrites the stored home offset. Read the warning on this page first.
methods.GetPositionPIDGain: Returns the position PID gains of one joint (`dev_name`) or of all joints of a component. Works only while the Control Manager is idle.
methods.SetPositionPIDGain: Writes position PID gains to the motor driver of the named joints; gains that are not set keep their value. Works only while the Control Manager is idle.
methods.SetPresetPosition: Sets the preset position of the named joint (PVL-based motors only). Rejected while the Control Manager is enabled.

admonitions.text: BrakeRelease: a joint whose servo is off is held only by its brake. When you release the brake, the joint can fall under gravity. Support the arm or torso and keep people clear before you release a brake.

HomeOffsetReset changes the zero of the joint. Every later position reading and command uses the new zero, so a wrong zero makes the robot move to wrong poses and can drive the joint past its real mechanical range. Use it only when a maintenance procedure tells you to.
SetPositionPIDGain changes the gains on the motor driver at once. Wrong gains can make a joint oscillate or move abruptly the next time it is controlled.

fields.name: Joint name, for example `right_arm_2`. Regex patterns are supported.

PowerService._source: core service/service.cpp PowerServiceImpl::JointCommand (same hardware calls as JointOperationService)

methods.PowerCommand: Turns the named power outputs on or off.
methods.JointCommand: Runs a joint command (servo on, brake engage, brake release or home offset reset) on the named joints. Brake release and home offset reset have the same risks as in JointOperationService.
methods.ToolFlangePowerCommand: Sets the tool flange power: off, 12 V or 24 V.

PowerCommandRequest._source: core service/service.cpp PowerServiceImpl::PowerCommand, robots/rby1a/robot_hardware.cpp ExecutePowerCommand (std::regex_match over 5v, 12v, 24v, 48v); rby1-sdk v0.10.1 src/robot.cpp PowerOn sets name

fields.name: Required. Regex for the power outputs: `5v`, `12v`, `24v` and `48v`. The whole name must match. Use `.*` for all outputs, as the SDK examples do. An empty name matches no output, so nothing changes, and the call still returns STATUS_SUCCESS.

JointCommandRequest._source: core service/service.cpp PowerServiceImpl::JointCommand, robots/rby1a/robot_hardware.cpp ServoOn (std::regex_match over the joint names); rby1-sdk v0.10.1 src/robot.cpp ServoOn sets name

fields.name: Required. Regex for the joint names, for example `right_arm_2`, `right_arm_.*` or `.*` for all joints. The whole name must match. An empty name matches no joint.

admonitions.text: COMMAND_BRAKE_RELEASE can let a joint fall under gravity, and COMMAND_HOME_OFFSET_RST changes the zero of the joint. Read the warnings on the JointOperationService page before you use them.
